title: Birth, marriage and death
about: Words for the big moments in family life: a new baby and birthdays, weddings and marriage, and saying goodbye when someone dies.

parts.title: Common mistakes
parts.note: Народитися — завжди was / were born: I was born in 2013. Прийменники: born in 2013, in May, in Lviv; on 5 May; at 6 o'clock. Одружитися з кимось — get married to, а не with. Три слова про смерть: died — дієслово (помер), dead — прикметник (мертвий, його немає в живих), death — іменник (смерть).

rows: I born in 2012. / I am born in 2012.
Ми назвали його Іваном на честь дідуся.
We called him Ivan after his grandad.
He dead two years ago. / He death two years ago.
He is died. / He is death.
His death made us very sad.
His dead made us very sad.

items.pattern: have a baby · had a baby
items.meaning: a mother has a new baby: her baby is born
items.uk: народити дитину; у неї народилася дитина
items.example: My aunt **had a baby** last week. It's a girl!
more: Our neighbours are going to **have a baby** in May.
When Mum **had** my little brother, I was six.
items.watchOut: «Народила дитину» — had a baby, а не got a baby і не born a baby. У розмові: She's had a baby! — У неї народилася дитина!

items.pattern: I was born · they were born · born in + year / month / place · on + date · at + time
items.meaning: come into the world; start your life
items.example: I **was born** in Lviv in 2013.
more: My little brother **was born** on 3 March.
Where **were** your parents **born**?
items.watchOut: Народитися — завжди was / were born: I was born in 2013. Не «I born» і не «I am born» про минуле. Прийменники: in 2013, in May, in Odesa; on 3 March; at 6 o'clock.

items.pattern: weigh + number · weigh – weighed
items.meaning: be a number of kilograms; also: find out how heavy something is
items.example: The baby **weighed** 3.5 kilograms when she was born.
more: My cat **weighs** five kilos. He loves food!
The shop assistant **weighed** the apples.
items.watchOut: gh не читається: weigh /weɪ/ звучить як way, weighed — /weɪd/. Кажуть просто He weighs 5 kilos, а не «is weighing 5 kilos».

items.pattern: call + person / pet + name · What are you going to call him?
items.meaning: give a name to a person or an animal
items.example: We **called** our new puppy Biscuit.
more: They're going to **call** the baby Sofia.
What did you **call** your cat?
items.watchOut: Без as: They called him Max (не called him as Max). Можна також name: They named him Max.

items.pattern: call / name sb after sb
items.meaning: give a baby the same name as another person, often someone in the family
items.example: My brother is called Petro, **after** our grandad.
more: She's called Maria **after** her grandmother.
We named the dog Elvis, **after** Dad's favourite singer.
items.watchOut: «Назвали на честь дідуся» — called him after his grandad. In honour of звучить дуже офіційно; у звичайній розмові кажуть after.

items.pattern: my birthday · on your birthday · Happy birthday!
items.meaning: the day every year when you remember the day you were born
items.example: My **birthday** is on 12 April.
more: What did you get for your **birthday**?
We're having a party for Grandma's 80th **birthday**.
items.watchOut: День народження — одне слово birthday, а не «day of birth» (у документах пишуть date of birth). У мій день народження — on my birthday.

items.pattern: be single
items.meaning: not married and without a partner
items.example: My uncle is 35 and he's still **single**.
more: My teacher is **single**, but she has a lot of friends and a big dog.
Lots of young people in the city are **single**.
items.watchOut: Single — одне слово і для чоловіків (неодружений), і для жінок (незаміжня). A single room у готелі — одномісний номер.

items.pattern: be married · be married to sb · be married for + years
items.meaning: having a husband or a wife
items.example: My older sister is **married**. Her husband's name is Taras.
more: My aunt **is married to** a vet.
My grandparents **were married** for 60 years.
items.watchOut: Одружений і заміжня — однаково married. За кого / з ким — to: She's married to Tom (не with Tom).

items.pattern: be widowed
items.meaning: your husband or wife has died
items.example: My grandmother **is widowed**. She lives with her sister now.
more: Grandad was **widowed** in 2015, and now he lives with us.
Mrs Brown is **widowed**, but she has lots of friends and grandchildren.
items.watchOut: Widowed — прикметник для чоловіків і жінок. Іменники: widow — вдова, widower — вдівець.

items.pattern: be separated
items.meaning: still married, but the husband and wife don't live together now
items.example: My friend's parents are **separated**. Her dad lives in another flat.
more: They were **separated** for a year, and then they got divorced.
Her parents are **separated**, but they both come to her school concerts.
items.watchOut: Separated — подружжя живе окремо, але офіційно ще не розлучене. Якщо шлюб закінчився за законом — divorced.

items.pattern: be divorced · get divorced
items.meaning: your marriage has ended by law
items.example: My uncle **is divorced**. He sees his children every weekend.
more: They **got divorced** when Tom was five.
Is she married? — No, she's **divorced**.
items.watchOut: Розлучилися — got divorced, а не «divorced with each other». Розлучитися з кимось — divorce sb, без with.

items.pattern: get married (to sb) · got married in + year
items.meaning: become husband and wife
items.example: My cousin Ira is going to **get married** in June.
more: My aunt and uncle **got married** on a sunny day in August.
Mum **got married to** Dad when she was 25.
items.watchOut: І «одружитися», і «вийти заміж» — get married. З ким — to: got married to Harry, не with Harry. Без get (They married in 2001) звучить офіційніше.

items.pattern: a wedding · go to a wedding · a wedding dress / cake
items.meaning: the day and the party when two people get married
items.example: We're going to my cousin's **wedding** on Saturday.
more: The **wedding** cake had five layers!
She wore her mum's old **wedding** dress.
items.watchOut: Wedding — весілля (свято). Marriage — шлюб (життя разом). Тому весільний торт — a wedding cake, а не marriage cake.

items.pattern: the bride · the bride and groom
items.meaning: a woman on her wedding day
items.example: The **bride** arrived at the wedding in an old red car.
more: Everyone said the **bride** looked beautiful.
The **bride**'s dress was blue, not white!
items.watchOut: Bride — наречена саме в день весілля. Наречена до весілля — fiancée.

items.pattern: the groom · the bridegroom · the bride and groom
items.meaning: a man on his wedding day
items.example: The **groom** was so nervous that he forgot his speech.
more: The bride and **groom** cut the cake together.
The **bridegroom** and his brother arrived early.
items.watchOut: Groom і bridegroom — те саме, groom кажуть частіше. Звичний порядок — the bride and groom (наречена й наречений).

items.pattern: go on (your) honeymoon (to + place) · be on honeymoon
items.meaning: a holiday that two people take just after their wedding
items.example: My aunt and uncle spent their **honeymoon** in the mountains.
more: They went on **honeymoon** to Greece for ten days.
Where did Mum and Dad go on their **honeymoon**?
items.watchOut: Honeymoon — це подорож, вона не обов'язково триває місяць: a one-week honeymoon. Поїхати — go on honeymoon, а не go to honeymoon.

items.pattern: be ill · become / get ill
items.meaning: not well; having a health problem
items.example: Grandma **is ill**, so we're going to visit her with some fruit.
more: Our teacher **is ill** today, so we have a different teacher.
Grandad **got ill** last winter, but now he's better.
items.watchOut: Захворіти — get ill / become ill. Ill зазвичай стоїть після дієслова: He is ill. Перед іменником частіше кажуть sick: a sick animal.

items.pattern: die – died · die in + year · die at the age of 90
items.meaning: stop living
items.example: My great-grandfather **died** in 2010, at the age of 92.
more: Our hamster **died**, so we buried him in the garden.
Some trees can live for 1,000 years before they **die**.
items.watchOut: Помер — died (дієслово). Не плутай: dead — мертвий (прикметник), death — смерть (іменник). Написання: die — dying (не dieing).

items.pattern: die of old age / an illness / a heart attack
items.meaning: the reason why someone stopped living
items.example: My great-grandmother **died of** old age. She was 98.
more: In the past, many children **died of** illnesses that doctors can cure today.
Grandad's goldfish lived for ten years and then **died of** old age.
items.watchOut: Від чого — зазвичай of: die of old age. Іноді кажуть і from, але не with і не by.

items.pattern: be dead · a dead animal / plant
items.meaning: not alive
items.example: This plant is **dead**. Let's buy a new one.
more: My grandparents on Dad's side are **dead**, but I've got lots of photos of them.
There are lots of **dead** leaves on the path in autumn.
items.watchOut: «Його вже немає в живих» — He is dead. Не «He is died» і не «He is death». Dead — прикметник, як ill чи happy.

items.pattern: death · sb's death · after sb's death
items.meaning: the end of someone's life
items.example: After Grandad's **death**, Grandma came to live with us.
more: The **death** of our old dog made everyone sad.
**Death** is a natural part of life.
items.watchOut: Death — іменник (смерть), а не дієслово: не «He death last year», а He died last year. Вимова: th у кінці, /deθ/, а не «дес».

items.pattern: a funeral · go to sb's funeral
items.meaning: a ceremony after someone dies, when people say goodbye to them
items.example: Lots of people came to Grandad's **funeral**.
more: People usually wear dark clothes to a **funeral**.
The **funeral** was on Tuesday, and then the family had lunch together.
items.watchOut: Похорон — funeral, в однині: a funeral, the funeral. Вимова: /ˈfjuːnərəl/ — «ф'юнерел», наголос на першому складі.

warmup.explain: Народити дитину — have a baby: She had a baby. Не got і не born.
Народитися — be born, у минулому часі was / were born.

warmup.uk: Ми назвали сина Іваном на честь дідуся.
warmup.q: We called our son Ivan, ___ his grandfather.
warmup.explain: На честь когось — after: called him Ivan after his grandfather.

warmup.uk: Моя тітка вийшла заміж за вчителя.
warmup.q: My aunt got married ___ a teacher.
warmup.explain: Одружитися з кимось — get married to sb, а не with.

warmup.uk: Після весілля вони провели тиждень в Іспанії — це був їхній медовий місяць.
warmup.q: After the wedding, they spent a week in Spain. It was their ___.

warmup.explain: Померти від чогось — die of: died of old age.

warmup.uk: Її дідуся вже немає в живих.
warmup.explain: Після is потрібен прикметник dead. Died — дієслово, death — іменник.

example.title: A big year for our family
example.uk:
Минулий рік був важливим для нашої родини. У травні моя тітка Олена вийшла заміж за вчителя на ім'я Марк. Наречена була в довгій білій сукні, а наречений дуже хвилювався. Після весілля вони поїхали у весільну подорож до Греції.

У грудні Олена народила дитину. Мій двоюрідний брат народився в мій день народження! Він важив три кілограми. Його назвали Петром на честь дідуся.

Тепер йому рік, і щороку в нас два торти на день народження.
example.en:
Last year was a big year for our family. In May, my aunt Olena [[got married|b6]] to a teacher called Mark. The [[bride|b8]] wore a long white dress, and the [[groom|b9]] was very nervous. After the [[wedding|b7]], they went on their [[honeymoon|b10]] to Greece.

In December, Olena [[had a baby|a1]]. My cousin [[was born|a2]] on my [[birthday|a6]]! He [[weighed|a3]] three kilos. They [[called|a4]] him Petro, [[after|a5]] his grandad.

Now he's one, and we have two birthday cakes every year.
